Description: GeForce® GTX 1660 Ti WINDFORCE OC 6G Features Powered by GeForce® GTX 1660 Ti, integrated 6GB GDDR6 memory with a 192-bit interface. WINDFORCE 2X cooling system with alternate spinning fans, 100 mm unique blade fans, and a protection back plate. Core clock: 1845 MHz (reference card: 1770 MHz). The WINDFORCE 2X cooling system uses two 100 mm unique blade fans, alternate spinning fan technology, 2 composite copper heat pipes with direct-touch GPU contact, and a 3D active fan, all working together for effective heat dissipation. Alternate spinning is GIGABYTE’s patented solution for reducing turbulent airflow between adjacent fans by rotating them in opposite directions so airflow moves the same way between the two fans, improving pressure and cooling efficiency. The unique blade fan shape splits airflow at the triangular edge and channels it smoothly through the 3D stripe curve on the fan surface to boost airflow. The 3D Active Fan provides semi-passive cooling, keeping the fans off during low-load or low-power gaming for near-silent operation when the system is light or idle. Pure copper heat pipes maximize direct contact with the GPU to improve heat transfer, and the heat pipes also extend over the VRAM via a large metal plate contact for proper cooling. The composite heat pipe combines thermal conductivity and phase transition to manage heat transfer between two solid interfaces more efficiently, increasing cooling capacity. Built strong for extreme durability and overclocking, the graphics card uses a 4+2 power phase design to keep MOSFETs cooler, along with over-temperature protection, load balancing for each MOSFET, and Ultra Durable certified chokes and capacitors for excellent performance and longer system life. The back plate adds an attractive finish while also strengthening the graphics card structure for full protection.
